environment.description: EC2 instance (c5.large) in private subnet (no IGW route) running the same Flask monolith. Origin is fronted by a CloudFront distribution with Origin Access Control (OAC) configured with a custom origin header (X-Origin-Verify) that must match a rotated secret. The distribution has a cache behavior with TTL min=1s/default=5s/max=30s for the /api/* path pattern. CloudFront's TCP connection pooling and TLS termination at 400+ edge locations introduces 15-80ms of non-deterministic latency variance per request. The origin security group restricts inbound to the CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. Signed URL policy requires requests to carry a valid CloudFront signature (RSA-SHA1 with key pair ID APKAEIBAERJR2EXAMPLE) with DateLessThan constraint, and the distribution's viewer protocol policy is set to redirect-to-https with field-level encryption profile applied to the request body 'token' field.

cloudfront_distribution.field_level_encryption: token field encrypted with RSA public key

config.direct_origin_access: blocked by SG + no public IP + no IGW route
